TS027 explicit-sized-types

A type spells its width, so the same program runs the same way on a smaller target.

languages: go odin rust zig
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable
javascript: JavaScript numbers are IEEE doubles and bigint is arbitrary precision, so there is no sized type to require
python: Python integers are arbitrary precision, so there is no sized type to require
typescript: TypeScript numbers are IEEE doubles and bigint is arbitrary precision, so there is no sized type to require

TigerStyle: "Use explicitly-sized types like `u32` for everything, avoid architecture-specific `usize`."
